notes.title: v2 Update: Time Trials, Exploration & FPS Camera Mode
notes.content:
Mountain Bicycle Rider Simulator is back with a major update! With this v2 update that takes the mountain biking experience to a whole new level, we have deepened both the content and the gameplay. You will now enjoy more missions, more discoveries and more excitement while pedaling on the peaks of the mountains.

v2 Update Notes
[list]
[*] Time Trial missions added: Test your reflexes and get rewards by reaching certain points before the time runs out.
[*] Skill missions added: Earn special rewards by showing various riding skills such as wheelie, jumping, and balancing.
[*] Exploration System added: Discover hidden areas across the stage and earn exclusive rewards! It's no longer just about riding — it's about what you can win through exploration!
[*] Animal Photography Challenges added: Complete special missions by photographing certain animals at the right time. An innovation that requires attention, intertwined with nature.
[*] Camera System renewed, FPS (First Person) Camera added: Now you can see the ride completely from your own eyes.
[*] UI adjustments have been made: Missions, controls and information screens have been made much more readable and modern.
[*] How to Play panel has been added: A guiding interface has been added for beginners. The in-game learning process is now much easier.
[*] Graphics quality has been increased and optimizations have been made: Clearer visuals, more vibrant atmosphere and a smoother experience even on low systems.
[*] All general bugs have been fixed: All bugs detected through player feedback have been fixed. The game is now much more stable and smooth.
[/list]
